What matters most

Night recording: A good Sony STARVIS 2 sensor can outperform a cheap camera advertised as 4K.

Supercapacitor: Preferable to a lithium battery for heat resistance.

Storage: Budget approximately $15–$25 for a high-endurance microSD card if not included.

Parking recording: Usually requires an additional hardwire kit.

One question: Do you want a front-only dash cam (better image quality for the money) or front + rear cameras (better overall coverage)? That changes which model I'd recommend.
